chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 10 (Full-Book Board Examination Simulator)
subject: chemistry-10

questions.question: When $Q_c = K_c$, the reaction is in a state of: (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Equality of $Q_c$ and $K_c$ indicates dynamic equilibrium.

questions.question: What is the pH of pure water at $25^\circ\text{C}$? (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
A substance that acts as an electron-pair donor is a Lewis: (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Lewis bases possess lone electron pairs available for coordinate covalent donation.

questions.question: Friedrich Wöhler synthesized urea from which inorganic compound? (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Heating ammonium cyanate converts it into urea.

questions.question: The functional group characteristic of aldehydes is: (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
Alkenes are characterized by the general formula: (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Acyclic alkenes contain one double bond, conforming to $C_nH_{2n}$.

questions.question: Which test uses cold alkaline $KMnO_4$ to detect unsaturation? (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Baeyer's test discharges purple $KMnO_4$ to form glycols.

questions.question: In DNA, adenine forms complementary hydrogen bonds with: (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Adenine pairs with thymine via two hydrogen bonds in DNA.

questions.question: Which vitamin deficiency causes rickets in children? (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Vitamin D deficiency causes impaired bone mineralization (rickets).

questions.question: The lapse rate of temperature in the troposphere is approximately: (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Temperature decreases at approximately 6.5°C per kilometer in the troposphere.

questions.question: Clark's method removes temporary water hardness by adding: (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Calculated slaked lime precipitates soluble bicarbonates as $CaCO_3$.

questions.question: In copper metallurgy, blister copper is approximately what percentage pure? (FBISE Full-Book Board Simulator)
questions.explanation: Blister copper from the Bessemer converter is ~98% pure copper.
